name: meters
description: Context window, 5-hour, weekly usage and the prompt cache countdown as compact meters in one band above the prompt or a side panel, with warnings, a going-cold notice and one-click handoff to a fresh session.

warnPercent.title: First context warning (%)
warnPercent.description: The context bar turns orange and warns that quality may start to slip.

redPercent.title: Context alert (%)
redPercent.description: The context bar turns red past this.

warnTokens.title: Context warning by size (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Same orange warning once the context holds this many tokens, whatever the percent (a 1M window).

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache window (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: Used until the real window is learned from the API's behaviour, or when you set one with /cache <minutes>.

notifyMinutes.title: Warn before the cache goes cold (minutes)
notifyMinutes.description: A notice this long before the prompt cache expires. Capped at half the window.

cacheStepMinutes.title: Cache countdown steps (minutes)
cacheStepMinutes.description: The countdown redraws every this many minutes (55m, 50m, ...). It resets to the full window each time you send a message.

handoffKey.title: Hotkey: new session with handoff
handoffKey.description: Chord pressed in the prompt box, e.g. meta+h. Empty turns it off.

freshKey.title: Hotkey: fresh session
freshKey.description: Chord pressed in the prompt box, e.g. meta+n. Empty turns it off.
